item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: Will Pakistan boycott India clash? ICC talks in focus
item.description: Uncertainty surrounds the India-Pakistan clash at the T20 World Cup 2026 as ICC and PCB officials meet in Lahore to resolve the dispute. Pakistan has hinted at boycotting the match, citing government directions and exploring force majeure provisions.

item.title: Budget Session 2026: Opposition to meet Kharge for floor strategy ahead of Parliament sitting
item.description: Parliament resumes at 11 am after a turbulent week of repeated disruptions triggered by protests over the India–US trade agreement and references to the Galwan clash book by former Army chief MM Naravane.

item.title: Sensex surges, Nifty climbs higher in strong market opening; Details here
item.description: Indian equity markets opened sharply higher with the Sensex soaring over 550 points and the Nifty crossing the 25,850 mark in the pre-opening session, driven by optimism around a potential trade deal and supportive global cues.

item.title: Gold and Silver rally sharply on weak Dollar; Investors eye next move
item.description: Gold and silver prices surged sharply on the MCX amid a weaker U.S. dollar, firm global demand, and rising expectations of Federal Reserve rate cuts. The rally extended across international markets, with other precious metals also trading higher.

item.title: Delhi School Bomb Threat: 9 Schools receive explosive warning emails; Security tightened
item.description: Panic gripped parts of Delhi after nine schools received bomb threat emails on Monday morning, prompting swift deployment of police, fire services, and bomb disposal squads. Authorities conducted thorough searches across campuses while cyber teams began tracing the origin of the threatening messages.

item.title: India, Canada strengthen security ties; NSA Ajit Doval holds high-level talks
item.description: India’s National Security Advisor Ajit Doval visited Canada to strengthen bilateral security and law enforcement cooperation. During high-level meetings in Ottawa, Doval and Canadian officials reviewed ongoing initiatives, agreed on appointing liaison officers, and discussed joint action against drug trafficking, organized crime, and cyber threats.

item.title: UP: Unknown vehicle hits motorcycle in Raebareli; One youth killed, two injured
item.description: The police are now searching for the unknown vehicle that caused this tragic accident. Witness statements are being recorded at the scene, and CCTV footage is being reviewed.

item.title: Suspected terrorist Abdul Rahman killed in Faridabad jail; Linked to Ram Temple bomb plot
item.description: Suspected terrorist Abdul Rahman was murdered inside Faridabad’s Neemka Jail by fellow inmate Arun Chauhary around 2 a.m. Rahman, arrested in March 2025 for his alleged role in a Ram Temple bombing plot, was from Kathua, Jammu &#38; Kashmir.

item.title: TNPSC exam cancelled today due to hall ticket irregularities; Full details
item.description: Tamil Nadu Public Service Commission (TNPSC) cancelled today’s exam due to irregularities in hall tickets. Many students, unaware of the issue, reached the exam centres only to be stopped from taking the test. The commission confirmed the cancellation and assured that a new exam date will be announced soon.

item.title: Opposition plans may move No-Trust Motion in Lok Sabha
item.description: As the Question Hour began, Opposition MPs raised slogans demanding their issues be addressed. Speaker OM Birla urged members to maintain decorum and said there would be no restriction on any MP speaking in the House.
